premise: Duckling starts a follow-the-leader game: Fox and Beaver copy everything he does — waddle, quack, head under a wing — then Beaver leads (gnaw a stick!), and when slow Snail arrives last, Duckling makes him the leader of the slowest parade the meadow has ever seen.
inspiration: The Pied Piper, turned gentle: a parade of friends copying the leader, and the leader hands the lead to the slowest one.
lesson: Everyone gets a turn to lead.

en-US.title: Follow the Duckling
en-US.text: [excited] Waddle, waddle, here came {duckling:enter} Duckling. {duckling:face happy} "Let's play follow the leader! Do what I do!" {fox:enter} Fox {fox:go to duckling} trotted in behind him. {beaver:enter} Beaver {beaver:go to fox} waddled in behind Fox. Duckling waddled. {fox:wobble} Fox waddled. {beaver:wobble} Beaver waddled. Duckling said {sfx:quack} "QUACK!" {fox:hop} Fox said "quack." {beaver:hop} Beaver said "quack." [giggles] Then Duckling {duckling:live nap hold} tucked his head under his wing. {fox:face sleeping} {fox:live tuck-tail hold} So Fox tucked his nose under his tail, {beaver:live hide-behind-stick} and Beaver hid behind his stick. [whispers] Shhh… {duckling:live nap resume} Pop! Out came Duckling. {sfx:quack} "QUACK!" {fox:live tuck-tail resume} {fox:face surprised} {beaver:face surprised} Everyone jumped. [laughs] "My turn!" said Beaver, and {beaver:live gnaw} {sfx:gnaw} he gnawed his stick. So Duckling nibbled a blade of grass. {fox:face happy} {fox:live chase-tail} And Fox nibbled his own tail! Then, slowly, slowly, along crawled {snail:enter} Snail, last of all. {snail:face sad} "Can I play?" [happily] "You can LEAD!" said Duckling. {snail:face happy} {duckling:go to snail} {fox:go to snail} {beaver:go to snail} So off went the parade behind Snail. Sloooowly. It took all afternoon, and nobody minded one bit.

es-ES.title: Todos detrás de Patito
es-ES.text: [excited] Bamboleándose, bamboleándose, llegó {duckling:enter} Patito. {duckling:face happy} —¡Vamos a jugar a imitar! ¡Haced todo lo que haga yo! {fox:enter} Zorro {fox:go to duckling} se puso detrás de él, al trote. {beaver:enter} Castor {beaver:go to fox} se colocó detrás de Zorro. Patito se bamboleó. {fox:wobble} Zorro se bamboleó. {beaver:wobble} Castor se bamboleó. Patito dijo {sfx:quack} «¡CUA!». {fox:hop} Zorro dijo «cua». {beaver:hop} Castor dijo «cua». [giggles] Entonces Patito {duckling:live nap hold} escondió la cabeza bajo el ala. {fox:face sleeping} {fox:live tuck-tail hold} Zorro metió el hocico bajo la cola, {beaver:live hide-behind-stick} y Castor se escondió detrás de su palo. [whispers] Chsss… {duckling:live nap resume} ¡Plop! Asomó Patito. {sfx:quack} —¡CUA! {fox:live tuck-tail resume} {fox:face surprised} {beaver:face surprised} Todos dieron un bote. [laughs] —¡Ahora me toca a mí! —dijo Castor, y {beaver:live gnaw} {sfx:gnaw} royó su palo. Así que Patito mordisqueó una brizna de hierba. {fox:face happy} {fox:live chase-tail} ¡Y Zorro se mordisqueó la cola! Entonces, despacito, despacito, llegó {snail:enter} Caracol, el último de todos. {snail:face sad} —¿Puedo jugar? [happily] —¡Tú vas el primero! —dijo Patito. {snail:face happy} {duckling:go to snail} {fox:go to snail} {beaver:go to snail} Y allá fue el desfile detrás de Caracol. Despaaacito. Tardaron toda la tarde, y a nadie le importó ni pizca.

ja-JP.title: アヒルの子の まねっこあそび
ja-JP.text: [excited]よちよち、{duckling:enter}アヒルの子がやってきました。{duckling:face happy}「まねっこあそび、しよう！」 {fox:enter}キツネくんが{fox:go to duckling}うしろにならんで、{beaver:enter}ビーバーくんも{beaver:go to fox}そのうしろへ。アヒルの子が、よちよち。{fox:wobble}キツネくんも、{beaver:wobble}ビーバーくんも、よちよち。アヒルの子が{sfx:quack}「ガー！」 {fox:hop}キツネくんも「ガー」。{beaver:hop}ビーバーくんも「ガー」。[giggles]こんどは、{duckling:live nap hold}つばさにあたまをかくしました。{fox:face sleeping}{fox:live tuck-tail hold}キツネくんは、しっぽにはなをうずめ、{beaver:live hide-behind-stick}ビーバーくんは、ぼうのうしろへ。[whispers]しーん…{duckling:live nap resume}ぴょこん！{sfx:quack}「ガーッ！」 {fox:live tuck-tail resume}{fox:face surprised}{beaver:face surprised}みんな、びくっ！[laughs]「こんどは、ぼく！」 とビーバーくん。{beaver:live gnaw}{sfx:gnaw}ぼうを、カリカリ。アヒルの子は、くさを、もぐもぐ。{fox:face happy}{fox:live chase-tail}キツネくんは、じぶんのしっぽを、かぷっ！ゆっくり、ゆっくり、さいごに{snail:enter}カタツムリくん。{snail:face sad}「いーれーて。」 [happily]「いいよ！せんとうをやって！」 {snail:face happy}{duckling:go to snail}{fox:go to snail}{beaver:go to snail}みんなで、カタツムリくんのうしろについて、ゆーっくり、ゆーっくり。ゆうがたまでかかっても、みんなへっちゃら。

de-DE.title: Alle hinter dem Entchen her
de-DE.text: [excited] Watschel, watschel, da kam {duckling:enter} das Entchen. {duckling:face happy} „Wir spielen Nachmachen! Macht alles, was ich mache!“ {fox:enter} Der Fuchs {fox:go to duckling} trabte hinter ihm her. {beaver:enter} Der Biber {beaver:go to fox} watschelte hinterher. Das Entchen watschelte. {fox:wobble} Der Fuchs watschelte. {beaver:wobble} Der Biber watschelte. Das Entchen sagte {sfx:quack} „QUAK!“ {fox:hop} Der Fuchs sagte „quak“. {beaver:hop} Der Biber sagte „quak“. [giggles] Dann {duckling:live nap hold} steckte das Entchen den Kopf unter den Flügel. {fox:face sleeping} {fox:live tuck-tail hold} Also steckte der Fuchs die Nase unter den Schwanz, {beaver:live hide-behind-stick} und der Biber versteckte sich hinter seinem Stock. [whispers] Pssst… {duckling:live nap resume} Plopp! Da war das Entchen wieder. {sfx:quack} „QUAK!“ {fox:live tuck-tail resume} {fox:face surprised} {beaver:face surprised} Alle machten einen Satz. [laughs] „Jetzt ich!“, sagte der Biber und {beaver:live gnaw} {sfx:gnaw} knabberte an seinem Stock. Also knabberte das Entchen an einem Grashalm. {fox:face happy} {fox:live chase-tail} Und der Fuchs knabberte an seinem eigenen Schwanz! Dann kam langsam, ganz langsam {snail:enter} die Schnecke angekrochen, als Allerletzte. {snail:face sad} „Darf ich mitspielen?“ [happily] „Du darfst VORNE gehen!“, sagte das Entchen. {snail:face happy} {duckling:go to snail} {fox:go to snail} {beaver:go to snail} So zog der lange Zug hinter der Schnecke her. Laaangsam. Es dauerte den ganzen Nachmittag, und das machte niemandem etwas aus.

fr-FR.title: Tous derrière Caneton !
fr-FR.text: [excited] Dandine, dandine, voilà {duckling:enter} Caneton. {duckling:face happy} « On joue ? Faites comme moi ! » {fox:enter} Renard {fox:go to duckling} s’est mis derrière lui en trottinant. {beaver:enter} Castor {beaver:go to fox} s’est dandiné derrière Renard. Caneton s’est dandiné. {fox:wobble} Renard s’est dandiné. {beaver:wobble} Castor s’est dandiné. Caneton a dit {sfx:quack} « COIN ! » {fox:hop} Renard a dit « coin ». {beaver:hop} Castor a dit « coin ». [giggles] Puis Caneton {duckling:live nap hold} a mis la tête sous l’aile. {fox:face sleeping} {fox:live tuck-tail hold} Alors Renard a caché son nez sous sa queue, {beaver:live hide-behind-stick} et Castor s’est caché derrière son bâton. [whispers] Chut… {duckling:live nap resume} Hop ! Revoilà Caneton. {sfx:quack} « COIN ! » {fox:live tuck-tail resume} {fox:face surprised} {beaver:face surprised} Tout le monde a sursauté. [laughs] « À moi ! » a dit Castor, et {beaver:live gnaw} {sfx:gnaw} il a rongé son bâton. Alors Caneton a grignoté un brin d’herbe. {fox:face happy} {fox:live chase-tail} Et Renard s’est mordillé la queue ! Puis, tout doucement, tout doucement, est arrivé {snail:enter} Escargot, le dernier de tous. {snail:face sad} « Je peux jouer ? » [happily] « C’est TOI le chef ! » a dit Caneton. {snail:face happy} {duckling:go to snail} {fox:go to snail} {beaver:go to snail} Et toute la parade est partie derrière Escargot. Tout douuucement. Ça a duré tout l’après-midi, et personne n’a trouvé le temps long.

it-IT.title: Tutti dietro ad Anatroccolo
it-IT.text: [excited] Dondola, dondola, ecco {duckling:enter} Anatroccolo. {duckling:face happy} «Gioco nuovo: fate come me!» {fox:enter} Volpe {fox:go to duckling} gli è andata dietro, al trotto. {beaver:enter} Castoro {beaver:go to fox} è andato dietro a Volpe. Anatroccolo si dondolava. {fox:wobble} Volpe si dondolava. {beaver:wobble} Castoro si dondolava. Anatroccolo ha fatto {sfx:quack} «QUA QUA!» {fox:hop} Volpe ha fatto «qua qua». {beaver:hop} Castoro ha fatto «qua qua». [giggles] Poi Anatroccolo {duckling:live nap hold} ha nascosto la testa sotto l'ala. {fox:face sleeping} {fox:live tuck-tail hold} Così Volpe ha infilato il muso sotto la coda, {beaver:live hide-behind-stick} e Castoro si è nascosto dietro il bastoncino. [whispers] Ssst… {duckling:live nap resume} Plop! Ecco Anatroccolo! {sfx:quack} «QUA QUA!» {fox:live tuck-tail resume} {fox:face surprised} {beaver:face surprised} Tutti hanno fatto un salto. [laughs] «Tocca a me!» ha detto Castoro, e {beaver:live gnaw} {sfx:gnaw} ha rosicchiato il bastoncino. Così Anatroccolo ha mordicchiato un filo d'erba. {fox:face happy} {fox:live chase-tail} E Volpe si è mordicchiata la coda! Poi, piano piano, è arrivata {snail:enter} Chiocciola, ultima di tutti. {snail:face sad} «Posso giocare anch'io?» [happily] «Fai TU la capofila!» ha detto Anatroccolo. {snail:face happy} {duckling:go to snail} {fox:go to snail} {beaver:go to snail} E via la sfilata, dietro a Chiocciola. Pianiiissimo. Ci hanno messo tutto il pomeriggio, e a nessuno è dispiaciuto per niente.

zh-TW.title: 跟著小鴨走
zh-TW.text: [excited]搖搖擺擺，搖搖擺擺，{duckling:enter}小鴨來了。{duckling:face happy}「我們來玩『跟我學』！我做什麼，你們就做什麼！」 {fox:enter}狐狸{fox:go to duckling}小跑步跟在牠後面。{beaver:enter}河狸{beaver:go to fox}搖搖擺擺地跟在狐狸後面。小鴨搖一搖。{fox:wobble}狐狸搖一搖。{beaver:wobble}河狸也搖一搖。小鴨說：{sfx:quack}「嘎！」 {fox:hop}狐狸說：「嘎。」 {beaver:hop}河狸說：「嘎。」 [giggles]接著，小鴨{duckling:live nap hold}把頭埋進翅膀底下。{fox:face sleeping}{fox:live tuck-tail hold}狐狸就把鼻子藏進尾巴裡，{beaver:live hide-behind-stick}河狸躲到木棍後面。[whispers]噓……{duckling:live nap resume}啵！小鴨冒出頭來。{sfx:quack}「嘎！」 {fox:live tuck-tail resume}{fox:face surprised}{beaver:face surprised}大家都嚇了一跳。[laughs]「換我了！」 河狸說完，{beaver:live gnaw}{sfx:gnaw}喀滋喀滋地啃起木棍。小鴨就啃了一片小草。{fox:face happy}{fox:live chase-tail}狐狸呢，竟然啃起自己的尾巴！這時，{snail:enter}蝸牛慢慢的、慢慢的爬來了，最後一個到。{snail:face sad}「我可以一起玩嗎？」 [happily]「你來帶頭！」 小鴨說。{snail:face happy}{duckling:go to snail}{fox:go to snail}{beaver:go to snail}於是，大家排成一隊，跟在蝸牛後面出發了。慢——慢——地走。走了一整個下午，可是誰也不介意。

zh-HK.title: 跟住小鴨做
zh-HK.text: [excited]一搖一擺，一搖一擺，{duckling:enter}小鴨來了。{duckling:face happy}「我哋玩『跟我做』！我做乜，你哋就做乜！」 {fox:enter}狐狸{fox:go to duckling}小步跑來，排在牠後面。{beaver:enter}海狸{beaver:go to fox}一搖一擺地排在狐狸後面。小鴨搖一搖。{fox:wobble}狐狸搖一搖。{beaver:wobble}海狸也搖一搖。小鴨叫：{sfx:quack}「嘎！」 {fox:hop}狐狸叫：「嘎。」 {beaver:hop}海狸叫：「嘎。」 [giggles]接着，小鴨{duckling:live nap hold}把頭藏進翅膀底下。{fox:face sleeping}{fox:live tuck-tail hold}狐狸就把鼻子埋進尾巴裏，{beaver:live hide-behind-stick}海狸就躲到木棍後面。[whispers]噓……{duckling:live nap resume}噗！小鴨鑽了出來。{sfx:quack}「嘎！」 {fox:live tuck-tail resume}{fox:face surprised}{beaver:face surprised}大家都跳了起來。[laughs]「輪到我喇！」 海狸說完，{beaver:live gnaw}{sfx:gnaw}就咔嚓咔嚓地咬起木棍來。於是小鴨咬了一片小草。{fox:face happy}{fox:live chase-tail}狐狸呢，竟然咬起自己的尾巴來！這時，{snail:enter}蝸牛慢慢地、慢慢地爬來了，是最後一個。{snail:face sad}「我可唔可以一齊玩呀？」 [happily]「你嚟帶頭！」 小鴨說。{snail:face happy}{duckling:go to snail}{fox:go to snail}{beaver:go to snail}於是，大家排成一行，跟着蝸牛出發了。慢——慢——地走。走了整整一個下午，可是誰也不介意。

quack.prompt: a single cheerful duckling quack, realistic
